messages:
zoe: Onboarding ember13b-int4-v2. Observed sporadic ghost tokens when resuming after a parallel eviction+prefetch at ~96k tokens. Not full repeats, just single-token ghosts that appear ~10-20 tokens after the boundary.

zoe: Repro command:
```bash
./local_eval --model ember13b-int4-v2 --streaming=1 --evict=98304 --prefetch=1 --prompt=very_long_anchor.txt
```

rahul: Can you share a tiny fragment of the failing sequence (ids)? Are the ghosted tokens copies of a prior nearby token?

zoe: Example (ids):
expected: ... 210 44 999 77 103 ...
observed: ... 210 44 999 77 999 ...  <-- ghosted 999 about 12 tokens after eviction boundary

mei: Interesting. Ember's rope_base was changed during v2 tuning (rope_base=12000). Could be RoPE phase wrap combined with prefetch overlap in the async restore path.

zoe: I toggled PREFETCH_PARALLEL=0 and the issue disappears in 30/30 runs. With parallel prefetch it fails ~1/150 runs.

build-bot: ci/run_longctx_smoke #88 queued by zoe

rahul: That points to a race in kvcache restore where pages are marked live before phase normalization. Quick test: set KVCACHE_VALIDATE_POS=1 to force validation after restore.

zoe: KVCACHE_VALIDATE_POS=1 reduced failures to 0/200 in my test.

mei: For mitigations: 1) keep PREFETCH_PARALLEL disabled for long streaming for now; 2) add post-restore position normalization (mod rope_cycle) and a tiny checksum; 3) add a CI smoke that runs streaming+evict+prefetch stress.

rahul: I'll open a runtime PR to gate PREFETCH_PARALLEL via model capabilities (capabilities.longctx.safe_prefetch=false for ember13b-int4-v2) and add the validation flag.

zoe: Filing ML ticket ML-3401 with repro and telemetry. Telemetry shows ~0.15% of real traffic hits this combo for ember13b in prod, so low but worth fixing.

mei: Agreed. Also let's add --ropecalc=float64 as an optional onboarding step to help triage similar drift issues.

zoe: Thanks all, will follow up when PR and canary are live.
